title: Asymptotic Analysis Q10 - Two Sequential Linear Passes
general_notes: No double deduction (except in points 10 and 11).
Students can use Theta or big-O notation with tight bounds.
The two linear passes (f's loop and g) run one after another, so their costs ADD and are NOT multiplied.
Intended answers: T_f(N) = Theta(N) and T_g(N) = Theta(N).

rubric_points.name: Splitting code into parts + referencing line numbers
rubric_points.target: Clear separation of f and g; loops vs non-loop code identified; line numbers referenced consistently.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Analysis does not clearly separate f vs g, or loops vs non-loops, and line numbers are unclear or missing.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Some attempt to separate components or refer to line numbers, but structure is incomplete or ambiguous.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Clear separation of f and g; f's linear loop and the call to g are identified; line numbers referenced consistently.

rubric_points.name: Constant-time non-loop parts
rubric_points.target: All non-loop code in f and g is Theta(1).

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Non-loop code not analysed or incorrectly claimed to be non-constant.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Some constant-time segments identified but others missing or vaguely stated.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: All non-loop regions (initialisations and returns in f and g) stated as Theta(1).

rubric_points.name: f(): Loop iterations
rubric_points.target: Theta(N) iterations of the for loop over a.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Iteration count missing or not Theta(N).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(N) but with weak or incomplete justification.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Justifies Theta(N) because i runs from 0 to N-1.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Claims non-constant per-iteration cost, or does not clearly state it.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Suggests constant time but with incomplete reasoning.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: States Theta(1): one array read, one multiplication and one += assignment.

rubric_points.name: f(): Total loop cost
rubric_points.target: Theta(N) from Theta(N) iterations x Theta(1) per iteration.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: No multiplication of iteration count x per-iteration cost, or total does not match own analysis.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Multiplies own values but final simplification or reasoning is unclear or incorrect.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(N) x Theta(1) = Theta(N).

rubric_points.name: f(): Cost of Part C (call to g + constant work)
rubric_points.target: Theta(N), accounting for the second linear pass g plus the constant-time addition and return.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Cost of Part C missing or incorrect.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Notes that cost comes from g but unclear about Theta(N).

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Accounts for the call to g as Theta(N) (a second linear pass) and the addition / return as Theta(1).

rubric_points.name: g(): Loop iterations
rubric_points.target: Theta(N) iterations of the for loop over a.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Iteration count missing or not Theta(N).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(N) but explanation is unclear.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Justifies Theta(N) because i runs from 0 to N-1.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Claims non-constant per-iteration cost, or does not clearly state cost per iteration.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Suggests constant time but lacks explicit Theta(1) justification.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Each iteration Theta(1): one array read and one += assignment.

rubric_points.name: g(): Total loop cost
rubric_points.target: Theta(N) = Theta(N) iterations x Theta(1) per iteration.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Does not combine iteration count x per-iteration cost.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Attempts multiplication using own values but unclear or incorrect.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(N) x Theta(1) = Theta(N).

rubric_points.name: Overall worst-case runtime of g
rubric_points.target: T_g(N) = Theta(N), summing constant parts and the loop.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Runtime absent or incompatible with earlier analysis.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(N) but with missing reasoning.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(1) + Theta(N) + Theta(1) = Theta(N).

rubric_points.name: Overall worst-case runtime of f
rubric_points.target: T_f(N) = Theta(N), adding the two sequential linear passes.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Final complexity missing/incorrect, or the two passes are multiplied to give Theta(N^2).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(N) but with missing reasoning, or unclear whether the passes add or multiply.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(1) + Theta(N) (loop) + Theta(N) (Part C) = Theta(N); the sequential passes add, they are not multiplied.
